messages:
maria: Quick FYI — I'm about to land a Terraform change to make our Karpenter provisioner prefer on-demand fallback when spot capacity < 30%. Wanted a quick runthrough on HPA interaction and secret wiring before I merge. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/PR/732

devon: link looks good. main question: will the fallback change any node labels that HPA podAffinity relies on?

maria: Good call. It will add node.karpenter.aws/fallback: "on-demand" as an annotation + provisioner.spec.weight bump. HPA uses nodeSelector: {instance-type: gpu} so shouldn't target fallback nodes, but some stateful jobs do attraction via affinity.

akeem: If those stateful jobs use podAntiAffinity + topologyKeys, they could still land. Recommend adding a taint on fallback nodes and tolerations only on the high-priority DA jobs. Something like:

```yaml
# provisioner patch snippet
provider:
  labels:
    karpenter.sh/capacity-type: spot
  extraAnnotations:
    node.karpenter.aws/fallback: on-demand
  taints:
    - key: karpenter.redwood/fallback
      value: true
      effect: NoSchedule
```

olivia: Agree with taint approach. Also note: i'm switching secret storage for the autoscaler webhook from SSM -> k8s secret (namespaced) so pods using that secret need serviceAccount binding changes. Maria, your PR touches the autoscaler service account?

maria: It doesn't yet. I planned to update the helm values in a follow-up but can bundle if you prefer. The new secret path will be `infra/autoscaler/webhook` in namespace `kube-system`.

devon: Bundle it. We should avoid a drift window where nodes fall back but webhook can't read certs. Also double-check IRSA role for the autoscaler SA if moving away from SSM access.

maria: Will bundle. Proposed helm tweak:

```yaml
autoscaler:
  enabled: true
  serviceAccount:
    annotations:
      eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::123456:role/infra-autoscaler
  secretName: autoscaler-webhook-secret
```

akeem: One more: VPA is still enabled in `dev` and `staging` namespaces. Are we planning to keep VPA + HPA on the same workloads? That can lead to thrashing.

olivia: We should disable VPA for deployment-backed webservices; keep VPA only for long-running batch jobs that need vertical scale. Add an annotation `vpa.kubernetes.io/exclude: "true"` on Deployments we want HPA-only.

maria: I'll add that annotation for the affected Helm charts. Also adding a guard: HPA targetCPU 50 with maxReplicas 30, min 2.

sre-bot: infra-lint check: terraform plan for PR/732 passed (no drifts), but detected missing taint on fallback nodes (suggested).

deploy-bot: PR/732 has a merge conflict with main (helm values) — request rebase.

devon: I'll take the rebase, push the secret/sa/taint changes in a single commit. @maria can you add a short rollout note for customer-facing teams?

maria: Yep — will add a one-paragraph in #product-announce + a short runbook: what to do if pods land on fallback nodes unexpectedly. :thumbsup:

olivia: Thanks — also remind SRE to check cluster-autoscaler metrics after rollout (nodeProvisionFailures, spotFallbackCount).

akeem: optional: add a prom alert for spotFallbackCount > 5/min during business hours.

maria: Will add alert to the PR. Planning to merge after rebase + you all ack.

devon: ack from me.

olivia: ack.

akeem: ack.

maria: merging after CI passes. Will post a short post-merge checklist.

deploy-bot: PR/732 merged by maria at 1765558600.
